edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender into _transfer, so the caller controls the transfer origin.
manualswap requires _msgSender() == _teamAddress, a caller-identity access check.
manualsend requires _msgSender() == _teamAddress, a caller-identity access check.
block.timestamp is read in _transfer for the cooldown comparison and assignment.
block.timestamp is used as the liquidity deadline inside openTrading.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline inside swapTokensForEth.
transfer invokes _transfer with _msgSender(), recipient and amount.
transferFrom invokes _transfer before adjusting the allowance.
_transfer delegates the actual balance update to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth, which performs an external router call before state finalization.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee which performs an external ETH transfer.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call allowing potential reentry.
sendETHToFee performs the external transfer to _teamAddress which may reenter.
openTrading performs the payable addLiquidityETH external call.
uniswapV2Router state variable is used to perform the token swap.
_teamAddress is the destination of the ETH transfer performed by sendETHToFee.
_taxFee is used in the fee arithmetic of _getValues.
_teamFee influences the team fee arithmetic in _getValues.
_rTotal is reduced by the reflected fee in _reflectFee.
setMaxTxPercent updates the owner-controlled _maxTxAmount state variable.
manualswap forwards the contract balance to swapTokensForEth.
manualsend forwards the contract ETH balance to sendETHToFee.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to apply the reflection transfer.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam to allocate the team portion.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee to account for reflected fees.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to compute transfer amounts.
constructor sets the _teamAddress state variable from the deployment argument.
openTrading assigns the created Uniswap pair to uniswapV2Pair.
setCooldownEnabled is an owner-only function that toggles cooldownEnabled.
ETH transfer to a contract recipient can invoke its receive/fallback function, enabling callback reentry.
